name: Empagliflozin
summary: A glucose-lowering drug that also shifted cardiology and nephrology by showing cardio-renal benefits beyond glycemic control.
good: Type 2 diabetes with heart failure or CKD benefit goals.
bad: Recurrent dehydration or infection-prone situations without review.
clinicalPearls: The modern reason to choose it is often cardio-renal benefit, not just A1c lowering.
mechanism: Blocks SGLT2 in the proximal tubule, increasing urinary glucose and sodium loss.
indications: Type 2 diabetes, heart failure, and chronic kidney disease in appropriate patients.
interactionNotes: Diuretics and dehydration-prone states raise concern because the drug adds osmotic diuresis.

warnings: Genital mycotic infections, volume depletion, and rare ketoacidosis are the practical warnings.
